mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original cook, one kitchen, one ingredient inventory and empty serving vessel. Show each irreversible material change through visible tool contact and retained ingredients. Keep pot, noodles, broth, cook and serving vessel traceable through parallel cooking duties. Drain and transfer the same cooked noodles into the previously established vessel without reset. Add retained toppings and end with the same adult presenting or tasting the complete dish. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.
